item.title: Vertex drops inhaled CF candidate
item.description:
• Summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals discontinued its inhaled cystic fibrosis (CF) candidate, developed in partnership with Moderna, after unresolved issues. The inhaled mRNA therapy aimed to correct the underlying CFTR defect.
  • MoAs: mRNA therapy encoding CFTR protein
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Passage Bio strategic review and layoffs after FDA setback
item.description:
• Summary: Passage Bio initiated a strategic review and 75% workforce reduction after the FDA blocked the clinical path for its gene therapy candidate (PBGM01 for GM1 gangliosidosis), requesting a different trial design.
  • MoAs: Gene therapy delivering functional beta-galactosidase enzyme
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech, BioSpace

item.title: Mirum anti-itch candidate Phase 2 win
item.description:
• Summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals reported positive Phase 2 results for its anti-itch candidate, being developed for pruritus associated with cholestatic liver diseases. The company plans to map an FDA path forward.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech
